About these figures

Click figures count content links only. Unsubscribe and mailto clicks are left out, so they will rarely match the Gainsight UI. Click tracking may not be enabled. "Not tracked" means no link in the email is click-tracked, so there is no figure. "(tracking unknown)" means the data cannot tell whether clicks are tracked: the figure is shown, and a 0 there may not be a real 0. A program reads tracked only when every one of its templates is.

About this page

This dashboard shows email engagement from the tenant's send log: comparisons across programs and periods, for every program it covers. It is one dashboard with one pull, built as an admin page and a leaders' page, and it is refreshed by hand; the data is as of the pull named below.

How to use this page

  • The filter bar under the tabs narrows the panels of the current tab: the months, a program picker (searchable; select all or none), the dashboard's groups, status, whether internal recipients count. The same filters carry across the tabs. The address bar keeps the filters you set, so a view can be bookmarked or shared; Reset filters clears them.
  • Tabs: Engagement, About.
  • A table with Show columns lets you pick the figures it shows and exports (remembered in this browser; Sent stays while a rate shows). Download current view (CSV) exports a panel as it stands: the active filters and the shown columns, every row. A chart has the same rows as a table underneath.
  • A plain 0% is a real 0%. "Not tracked" means no link in the email is click-tracked, so there is no number. A figure marked "(tracking unknown)" is shown, but the data cannot tell whether clicks are tracked.
  • * marks a figure that includes the provisional period; † marks one that includes months carried forward from an earlier pull.

Definitions

Sent
Every email attempt in the period, whether or not it went out. Every recipient and every repeat send counts. Calculation: COUNT of rows
Delivered
Attempts that went out and did not bounce. An attempt that went out and bounced afterwards counts as bounced, not delivered. Calculation: COUNT of rows
Opened
Attempts flagged as opened. An open is an image-pixel load. Calculation: COUNT of rows
Clicked
Attempts with at least one click on a content link. Unsubscribe and mailto links do not count. Calculation: COUNT of rows
Open rate
The share of delivered attempts that were opened. Calculation: Opened ÷ Delivered Blank, never 0%, when Delivered is 0.
Click rate
The share of delivered attempts with a content-link click. Calculation: Clicked ÷ Delivered Blank, never 0%, when Delivered is 0.

This dashboard's settings

Dashboard
"program-health", a dashboard spec of version 1.
Title
Acme program health
Owner
Acme CS Ops
Tenant
Refreshed from acme.gainsightcloud.com, and from no other tenant.
Data source
Journey Orchestrator email engagement, read from the tenant's send log.
Programs
Only programs that have sent since 90 days before each refresh. A program's status never limits what is pulled; the status filter decides what shows.
Window
The last 13 months, the current one included. The current month is provisional: opens keep arriving.
Failure settings
A program whose ingest has run 5 due days admitting nobody is listed as "Admitting nobody". A health pull samples failure text for at most 25 programs, most failures first. No failure wording of the tenant's own is named as expected.
Internal recipients
Addresses at the company's own 1 email domain are internal.
Unsubscribe link
Clicks on the tenant's own 1 unsubscribe link are unsubscribe clicks, not content clicks.
Named accounts
0 test accounts and 1 pinned account. Named accounts are always kept as their own rows when accounts are pulled.
Step detail
Off: emails are reported per template, with the step's name where a template sits on one step. Turning it on adds step, variant and participant-record figures and makes each refresh longer.
Months read again
A refresh reads the last 2 months again and keeps earlier months as they were last read.
Filters
Date range: the months shown.
Programs: a searchable list of every program in the dashboard.
Group: the dashboard's own supergroups and groups.
Status: Active, Paused, Draft or Stopped, as of the last refresh.
Recipients: everyone, or external recipients only (the company's own domains and test accounts left out); starts on everyone.
Accounts
Customer lists are on: across programs over the whole window, the 25 most engaged (at least 10 delivered), the 25 least engaged (at least 10 delivered), the 25 most bounced; every kept account has its own rows on every program it is on. Every other account is in one "all other accounts" row per program, so totals stay exact.
Groups
1. Supergroup "Surveys": programs that send a survey.
2. Supergroup "Internal": programs sent to internal users.
3. Supergroup "Recurring": programs on a recurring schedule.
4. Supergroup: programs by folder: Renewals (folder id 202). Folder names are not available from Gainsight, so each label is the one given here.
5. Group "CSAT" (inside Surveys): programs whose model is CSAT_SURVEY_V2.
6. Group: programs by name: part 2 of the name, split on " ", is the group.
1 program placed by hand, ahead of any rule.
Rules apply in the order listed, supergroups first. A program no rule reaches is in "Ungrouped".
Silent programs
An Active program with no send in 45 days is listed as silent.
Knowledge base
Each refresh re-documents the programs the knowledge base is behind on (modified since documented, or never documented) and fetches the email templates it lacks, up to 50 assets per refresh; the rest wait for the next one. What is still behind is marked on the page.
Pages
"Admin" (admin): for the people who run the programs: every tab, per-program and per-email detail, account names. Tabs: engagement, health, templates, about. Shows programs of every status at first; the others are one click away. Starts on the whole window, with the current month marked provisional. No panel of its own: the admin preset's 17 panels. Account names may show; definitions show the object, fields and filters behind each number; template text (subjects, bodies, the keyword search) is on the page.
"This period" on the engagement tab: headline figures, each beside the usual and the change against it of Sent, Delivered, Opened, Open rate, Click rate.

"Emails" on the engagement tab: a table of Sent, Delivered, Opened, Open rate, Click rate by program and template.
"Steps" on the engagement tab: a table of Sent, Delivered, Opened, Open rate, Click rate by program and step and variant.
"Survey responses" on the engagement tab: a table of Survey participants, Submitted, Partially submitted, Any response, Response rate by program.
"Most engaged customers" on the engagement tab: a ranked short list of accounts across programs, with each account's programs underneath of Delivered, Opened, Open rate, Bounced by account, the top 25 by Open rate.
"Least engaged customers" on the engagement tab: a ranked short list of accounts across programs, with each account's programs underneath of Delivered, Opened, Open rate, Bounced by account, the top 25 by Open rate.
"Most bounced customers" on the engagement tab: a ranked short list of accounts across programs, with each account's programs underneath of Delivered, Opened, Open rate, Bounced by account, the top 25 by Bounced.
"Send health" on the health tab: headline figures, each beside the usual and the change against it of Error rate, Bounce rate, Rejected rate, Unsubscribe rate, Spam complaint rate.
"Program health" on the health tab: program health: every Active program's signals and the one list it lands on, with the no-send threshold adjustable in the page; the no-send threshold starts at 45 days (14, 30, 60 and 90 are one click away).
"Why sends and participants fail" on the health tab: why sends and participants fail, by category, each against its usual, with expected failures (business rules working) behind a toggle; expected failures are behind a toggle.
"Schedules" on the health tab: each program's schedule as the knowledge base documents it, with the day it is as of and a stale mark; a schedule documented more than 45 days before the pull is marked stale.
"One-time and ad-hoc programs" on the health tab: one-time and ad-hoc programs with their send history; each program's sends over the last 6 months.
"Error rate by program" on the health tab: a table of Sent, Send failures, Error rate, Bounced, Bounce rate, Rejected, Rejected rate, Unsubscribed, Unsubscribe rate, Spam complaints, Spam complaint rate by program.
"Emails: text and search" on the templates tab: each email's performance per program and step, its current text, and keyword search over subjects and bodies; a search hit shows 50 characters of context either side.
"Leadership" (exec): for leaders who read the numbers: Engagement and About, every status, no account names. Tabs: engagement, about. Shows programs of every status at first; the others are one click away. Starts on the closed months, with the current month one click away. No panel of its own: the exec preset's 6 panels. Account names never show; definitions do not show the object, fields and filters behind each number; template text (subjects, bodies, the keyword search) is not on the page.
"Headline" on the engagement tab: headline figures, each beside the usual and the change against it of Sent, Delivered, Open rate, Click rate.
"Open rate by month" on the engagement tab: a monthly trend of Open rate, Click rate by month.
"Sends by month" on the engagement tab: a bar chart of Sent, Delivered, Opened by month.
"By group" on the engagement tab: a table of Sent, Delivered, Open rate by supergroup and group.
"Top programs by open rate" on the engagement tab: a table of Sent, Open rate by program, the top 10 by Open rate.
"Lowest open rates" on the engagement tab: a table of Sent, Open rate by program, the top 10 by Open rate.

Caveats

  • 1 program(s) have no full doc in the knowledge base, so their emails are listed by template name, without step names.
  • Step names come from the knowledge base, as of the date each program was last documented (the oldest is 2026-08-20T00:00:00.000Z). A step renamed since then shows its earlier name.
  • Sends on or after 2026-09-01 are provisional: opens keep arriving, so the recent period reads low. Bounces and unsubscribes on sends since 2026-08-01 can still change too: a refresh reads those months again.
  • Opens are image-pixel loads. Apple Mail Privacy Protection and security scanners inflate them, and blocked images hide real ones. Compare programs with each other, not with an outside benchmark.
  • Open rate and click rate divide by Delivered (went out and did not bounce). A send that was opened and bounced afterwards counts as opened and not delivered, which can lift the rate of a very small group.
  • Click figures count content links only. Unsubscribe and mailto clicks are left out, so they will rarely match the Gainsight UI.
  • Click tracking may not be enabled. "Not tracked" means no link in the email is click-tracked, so there is no figure. "(tracking unknown)" means the data cannot tell whether clicks are tracked: the figure is shown, and a 0 there may not be a real 0. A program reads tracked only when every one of its templates is.
  • Program status is today's status. There is no status history.
  • 4 CC copies are left out: only "To" recipients are counted.
  • 4 email(s) sent by other Gainsight features are left out: only Journey Orchestrator sends are counted.
  • 12 send(s) name no template. They are counted in their program, on a row with no template.

How to refresh

An admin refreshes this page by hand; the data-pulled line at the top says when it was last done.
